name: Iron Horse Acquisitions II Corp.
summary: Iron Horse Acquisitions II Corp. operates as a special purpose acquisition company, or SPAC. Its primary mission is to finalize a business combination, which could involve a merger, an asset or share acquisition, a reorganization, or a similar transaction with one or more existing enterprises. This entity was established on November 26, 2024, and maintains its principal offices in Boca Raton, Florida.
